counterexample_attempts: Recomputed the campaign’s canonical hash as SHA-256 of json.dumps(parsed_submission, sort_keys=True); it exactly matches the immutable source hash.
Reimplemented polynomial arithmetic over GF(2). Both displayed Frobenius congruences and Euclidean identities hold, and gcd(p,U^256+U)=1.
Tried to factor p through every possible proper factor degree allowed by U^(2^16)-U. The gcd at exponent 8 excludes degrees 1, 2, 4, and 8, leaving only degree 16.
Checked the kernel and complete weight cases of H: z=0 has weight 0, z=theta^15 has weight 32768, and every other nonzero z has weight 16384.
Tried to obtain an encoder kernel from a nonzero degree-at-most-64 polynomial. This would require 32768 distinct roots, contradicting the degree bound.
Tracked the exceptional inner symbol explicitly. If f has r roots and e surviving values equal to theta^15, then wt(c_f)=(32768-r+e)2^14, so exceptional symbols can only increase weight.
Tried to break the equality witness by making every scalar forbidden. At most 32704 scalars are forbidden, whereas F* has 65535 elements, so an admissible deterministic scalar necessarily exists.
Checked the degree-at-most-65 extension: a scaled 65-root word has weight 32703*16384=535805952, exactly 16384 below the target.
